name: kb_768_Normalized

https:__kubernetesjsonschema_dev_master_.description: Time is a wrapper around time.Time which supports correct marshaling to YAML and JSON.  Wrappers are provided for many of the factory methods that the time package offers.

schema.description: PriorityLevelConfigurationCondition defines the condition of priority level.

lastTransitionTime.description: `lastTransitionTime` is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.

message.description: `message` is a human-readable message indicating details about last transition.

reason.description: `reason` is a unique, one-word, CamelCase reason for the condition's last transition.

status.description: `status` is the status of the condition. Can be True, False, Unknown. Required.

type.description: `type` is the type of the condition. Required.

description: The last transition occurred at 2024-10-12T08:45:30Z. The condition type is Ready with a status of True. The change was triggered for the reason ConfigurationUpdated, and the system reported: “Priority level configuration has been successfully applied.”

reference_json.message: Priority level configuration has been successfully applied.
